Talks

git log --oneline -- talks/

I speak about software craftsmanship, engineering culture, agile without the ceremony, and Git. Over the years that has meant conferences across Europe and the Middle East, more than 200 seminars at companies and universities, and many community meetups.

Below are the conferences, meetups, universities and webinars I could trace, newest first. Slides are on Speaker Deck and recordings on YouTube. Some talks left no slides or recording behind. They are listed too. Organizers will find a speaker bio at the end of the page.

A day appears next to an event only where the date is known.

Speaker bio

Lemi Orhan Ergin is a software crafter based in Istanbul and the co-founder and Chief Software Crafter of Craftgate, a payment orchestration platform. He has been programming since 2001 and has held technical leadership and coaching roles at Sony, eBay/GittiGidiyor, ACM and iyzico. He founded the Software Craftsmanship Turkey community in 2014, has organized more than 200 meetups, and hosts the Turkish podcast Lemi'nin Not Defteri.
